name: Harvest Valley landscape and farm detail
rationale: Thirty-one separately measured sources inspected in six canonical RGB views each. Add mature canopy, mixed woodland, orchard trees, groundcover, garden borders, static fence sections and agricultural props to the compact rural settlement. Defective texture projections were excluded. Source names were discovery hints; admission uses visible identity, exact dimensions, contact, resource integrity and existing broad concepts. Each source remains its own singleton entry.
